forbidden_patterns.reason: FIPS 140-3 / STIG V-222645: MD5 is cryptographically broken and not FIPS-compliant.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Replace with MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256") or stronger FIPS-approved algorithms.

forbidden_patterns.reason: FIPS 140-3 / NIST SP 800-131A: SHA-1 is deprecated and not FIPS 140-3 compliant.
FIPS 140-3 / STIG V-222645: DES is cryptographically broken. FIPS 140-3 forbids its use.
FIPS 140-3: RC4 and RC2 are cryptographically broken stream ciphers forbidden by FIPS.
OWASP A03 / DISA STIG V-222540: Runtime.exec() with string arguments is vulnerable to command injection.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Pass command as a String array: Runtime.getRuntime().exec(new String[]{"cmd", "arg1"}), or preferably use ProcessBuilder with explicit argument list.

forbidden_patterns.reason: OWASP A03: ProcessBuilder constructed via string concatenation may be vulnerable to command injection.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Build the ProcessBuilder argument list using a pre-validated String array, never via concatenation with user-controlled values.

forbidden_patterns.reason: OWASP A03: SQL query constructed via string concatenation is vulnerable to SQL injection.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Use PreparedStatement with parameterized queries: PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement("SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?"); ps.setInt(1, userId);

forbidden_patterns.reason: OWASP A08: Unfiltered ObjectInputStream deserialization can execute arbitrary code from malicious serialized objects.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Implement an ObjectInputFilter to whitelist allowed classes before deserializing, or replace with a safe serialization format (JSON/XML).

forbidden_patterns.reason: DISA STIG: JDWP (Java Debug Wire Protocol) must never be enabled in production environments.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Remove all -agentlib:jdwp JVM options from production configurations and startup scripts.

forbidden_patterns.reason: OWASP A07 / NIST IA-5: Hardcoded password detected in source code.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Remove hardcoded credentials. Retrieve passwords from environment variables or a secrets manager (AWS Secrets Manager, HashiCorp Vault).

forbidden_patterns.reason: OWASP A02 / NIST SC-8: Disabling hostname verification or trusting all certificates enables MITM attacks.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Use proper TLS certificate validation. Never disable hostname verification in production code.

forbidden_patterns.reason: STIG V-222643 / NIST SP 800-52: SSLv3, TLS 1.0, and TLS 1.1 are deprecated protocols.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Use SSLContext.getInstance("TLSv1.3") or "TLSv1.2" and explicitly disable older protocol versions.
